newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Iddison revises year loss to NZ$1.55 mln.
newsitem.headline: Iddison revises year loss to NZ$1.55 mln.

text.p: Iddison Group Vietnam Ltd said on Tuesday it would report a loss of NZ$1.55 million in its annual report for the year ended March 31, instead of the $1.16 million loss reported in its June 16 preliminary announcement.
The project investment company's revised loss includes $389,415 of previously deferred development costs in a poultry project, which have been expensed in that financial year.
This was a result of the directors reconsidering the stage at which a project enters the development phase for the purposes of accounting for research and development costs.
"This is considered a conservative approach bearing in mind that the poultry project should become operational in the current year," Iddison said.
